title: Jesus... Why Did You Let Peter Sink?

bible.text: Peter got down out of the boat, walked on the water and came toward Jesus. But when he saw the wind, he was afraid and, beginning to sink, cried out, "Lord, save me!" Immediately Jesus reached out his hand and caught him. "You of little faith," he said, "why did you doubt?"

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... why did Peter start sinking when he was already walking toward You? 😟

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: He actually stepped out of the boat. He was doing what nobody else dared to do.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Peter looked at Me and stepped forward. For a moment, his fear did not control him.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Then he looked at the wind... and everything changed.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Yes. His eyes moved from Me to the storm around him.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: So he didn't sink because the storm suddenly became stronger?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: The storm was already there. What changed was what Peter was looking at.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: That's me... I start with faith, but then I look at my problems, my future, everything that could go wrong... and I panic.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Then remember Peter. When he cried out, I didn't stand far away and watch him sink. I reached for him.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Faith doesn't mean you never feel afraid. When fear takes your eyes away from Me, turn back. My hand is still reaching for you. 🤍

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: What has been taking your eyes off Jesus lately? 🌊 Leave a 🙏 if you're choosing to look back to Him.
